stats: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite-sheet for a dice roll animation. Create ONE transparent PNG, 4 columns by 3 rows of EXACTLY 12 equally sized cells, total 1536x1024. Input reference is the design of the single violet crystal, gold-trimmed numbered stat die. Each cell depicts the SAME die at a different successive tumbling orientation, centered with a full generous transparent margin. Read row-major left to right, frames 1 to 12 form a clear airborne tumble, impact and settling sequence. Preserve the reference die's materials and silhouette, but actually redraw different visible faces/orientations, do NOT repeat a static pose. Frame 1 poised, 2-4 tossing up, 5-8 fast tumble, 9 impact with a brief small magical spark, 10-12 settling upright. Exactly one die per cell. Small coherent violet magic trails only inside each cell, no large glow or floor. No text, no numerals labeling cells, no UI borders, no background, no checkerboard. High-end Korean fantasy RPG item illustration, crisp at 160px. This is an animation asset, not a mockup.

kit:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FOUR production raster UI assets arranged in a precise 2 by 2 sheet, 1536x1536 total, exactly equal 768x768 cells with no grid lines. Fantasy RPG pet codex workshop, midnight ink blue lacquer, fine antique champagne gold, restrained luminous jade accents, beautifully painted real material. No text anywhere.
Top-left cell: one square UI PANEL plate, nearly fills cell with 30px exterior transparent margin; slim double metal rim and elegant corner joinery, large perfectly empty flat midnight-blue interior for readable UI text. Suitable for nine-slice scaling. No central decoration.
Top-right cell: one horizontal ACTION BUTTON plate, 680px wide and 200px tall, centered in the cell; softly beveled antique-gold rim, deep teal lacquer face, subtle engraved corner curls, center blank, enough contrast for ivory live text. Transparent area outside button.
Bottom-left cell: a single PET CODEX BOOK ICON, closed dark teal leather volume with polished gold paw-shaped clasp and two parchment bookmarks, centered, full object fits within 500x500, no letters, transparent outside the icon.
Bottom-right cell: a square PORTRAIT BACKDROP plate, nearly fills cell with 30px exterior margin; lush but dark moonlit pet sanctuary, ancient stone arch, a subtle gold astrolabe motif above, low circular stone platform, tiny teal lights at the sides. The CENTER must remain dark and uncluttered to display a pet image. No creature, no human, no text.
Keep all four assets entirely within their cells, isolated from one another. High-end painted fantasy game UI texture; refined and functional, no synthetic wireframes, no app mockup, no glass UI.
